tips.text: §e[Quick actions] §fEnter §bkt §fto view the quick actions provided by the core.
§a[Accessories] §fEquip accessories in the appropriate §bCurios slots§f to activate their effects.
§6[Wallet] §fStore your coins in a wallet to free up inventory slots.
§d[Quests] §fShop exchanges may require quests. Check the required tasks and materials first.
§b[Exploration] §fNote your base coordinates before leaving, and bring food and light sources.
§c[Safety] §fWatch for monsters at night and in caves. Keep areas lit and leave yourself an escape route.
§e[Loading] §fThis tip is only visible while §bLoading the world§f. Useful for performance tips.
§a§l[Biome] §fYou are in Nether Wastes! Wear gold armor to stop Piglins from attacking.
§d§l[Item] §fYou found an Elytra! Use fireworks for infinite flight.
